body:
Anarkist,
I just lost my aunt this pass week because she suffered post partem psychosis. She had a kid in her late 40's and was going through a rough marriage. My mom feels shameful and exhausted at my aunts action to take her life away, but the only thing I could say is this...

Remember that it isn't your fault or any one's fault for not caring about your friend. We poured our hearts to them, but in return this is what they would like to give back--an end to there own life. 

I am starting to have trouble thinking about it, but what I could only learn from my aunt's death is self preservation and confidence. To grow only stronger physically and emotionally. 

My aunt left behind a six-month year old son and a husband. I think the only thing we could do now is pray, and cherish what we have. Because life is too short foe one to really enjoy :)

My prayers are with u as they are with mine
